game.title: PACKARDOS
game.description:
PACKARDOS is an unofficial Pokémon fan game about collecting virtual cards. Begin with two unlimited free expansions, then keep, sell, or grade your pulls to fund access to older sets. The collection spans 4,240 cards across 35 expansions and 18 tiers, leading toward 1st Edition Base Set.

Albums, custom binders, collector requests, and automation give the collection a longer progression loop. This free prototype is unaffiliated with Pokémon’s rights holders; its cards have no real-world monetary value.
game.how_to_play: Open packs and reveal their cards. Decide which to collect, sell, or send for grading. Reinvest earnings in expansions and upgrades; use albums and collection filters to track missing cards.
game.controls:
Click / Space / Enter — continue
R — another pack
B — album
L — grading
U — upgrades
M — sound
Esc — close
Mouse or touch — full interface control
game.tips:
Check collector requests before selling valuable cards.
Export a save from Settings before clearing browser data or changing browsers.
game.features:
Card grading from 1 to 10
Searchable collection, favorites, and wishlist
Custom binders
135 achievements
Batch openings and automation
Browser autosave with export
game.short_description: Open virtual Pokémon card packs, grade your finds, and unlock older expansions.

game.title: Azzucca
game.description:
Azzucca combines tower defense with incremental upgrades in a short autumn jam prototype. As a witch, protect a pumpkin tree from nightly attacks while using daylight to build towers and develop your skill tree.

Your position matters: entering a tower room warms you and boosts that room’s firing rate while doubling its projectiles. Survive ten waves to win, or continue with the simple endless mode. Created for Mini Jam 221: Autumn.
game.how_to_play: Build defenses and purchase skill-tree improvements during the day. When enemies arrive at night, move into a tower room to strengthen its attack. Keep the pumpkin tree safe through all ten waves.
game.controls:
Arrow keys / A, D — movement
W / Space — jump
game.tips:
Spend daylight preparing before the next wave.
Support the room covering the busiest approach to make use of its doubled projectiles.
game.features:
Daytime building and nighttime defense
Skill-tree progression
Room-based attack buffs
Ten-wave victory condition
Endless mode
Pixel-art presentation
game.short_description: Defend a pumpkin tree through ten nights with towers, upgrades, and a witch’s warming presence.

game.title: II II II I I I I II
game.description:
Content warning: self-harm and psychological distress. II II II I I I I II is a short, surreal interactive narrative by II-P that explores a person’s difficult emotional experiences through a recurring late-night setting.

The game uses a stark black-and-white presentation, dialogue, and choices, with multiple endings listed by the developer. A browser version is available, although the creator recommends the downloadable build for the best experience.
game.how_to_play: Read the dialogue, follow the interactive tutorial, and make the choices offered by the story. Progress through its scenes to reach an ending.

Space / left mouse button — advance dialogue
Hold Enter — skip dialogue and tutorial
Down / Up — hide / show text box
M — mute / unmute music
game.tips:
Read the tutorial before using the dialogue-skip shortcut.
Use the text-box visibility keys when you want a clearer view of a scene.
game.features:
Psychological interactive fiction
Meaningful story choices and multiple endings
Black-and-white visuals
Subtitles and interactive tutorial
English text
Music featuring soma

game.title: We Need More Undead!
game.description:
We Need More Undead! is an incremental prototype about building a necromancer’s army. Your undead spawn, march, and fight automatically, earning souls as they push through hostile territory.

Spend those souls on a branching upgrade tree to increase army size, health, and speed. New undead types and abilities expand your options, while directly cursing enemy towers lets you support the advancing army.
game.how_to_play: Let the army advance and earn souls. Spend them in the upgrade tree, then repeat as stronger forces push farther. Click enemy towers to disable them temporarily and unlock additional undead types as progress allows.
game.controls:
Mouse click on enemy towers — temporarily disable them
Use the on-screen upgrade tree to purchase improvements
game.tips:
Use tower curses when your army is approaching a defended position.
If progress slows, consider survivability and speed upgrades as well as army size.
game.features:
Automatic spawning and combat
Soul-based progression
Army upgrade tree
Temporary tower curses
Unlockable undead types and abilities
game.short_description: Grow an automated undead army and use soul-funded upgrades to overwhelm enemy defenses.

game.title: One Way Down
game.description:
One Way Down is an isometric mining clicker built around a 100-metre descent. Break blocks for gold, recruit specialist workers, and choose among 71 upgrades across five connected branches. Six biomes hide monsters, artifacts, and a boss every tenth metre.

Workers gain experience, but deaths are permanent and replacements start over. Finish an expedition to develop Base Camp, recruiting five persistent characters and building a network of 21 improvements that help future runs. The game is free and open source under GPL v3.
game.how_to_play: Click blocks to mine and earn gold. Hire crew and buy upgrades as you descend. Attack monsters that grab workers, defeat the ten bosses, and reach the bottom. Spend time at camp improving the next expedition.
game.controls:
Click blocks — mine
Click a monster holding a miner — attack it
Use on-screen hiring and upgrade options
game.tips:
Respond quickly when a worker is grabbed to avoid losing their experience.
Use camp improvements to support later expeditions.
Consider combat upgrades before deeper boss encounters.
game.features:
Six biomes and ten bosses
Specialist miners with leveling
71 expedition upgrades
Persistent camp progression
Expedition artifacts
61 achievements
game.short_description: Lead a mining crew through six underground biomes, then improve camp for the next expedition.

game.title: Fake News Detective (In Space)
game.description:
Fake News Detective (In Space) is an educational point-and-click puzzle game set on the planet Shrim. Its residents need help judging online articles, and each level asks you to investigate an uncertain piece of reporting.

Use the game’s web search, reverse image search, source links, AI checker, and warning-sign checklist to gather evidence before deciding whether an article is trustworthy. The project began at the Digiwise GameJam in Leipzig and remains in development; the available release is presented as a demo. English and German are listed as supported languages.
game.how_to_play: Launch the browser player and read the article presented in a level. Explore the investigation tools, compare the evidence with the checklist, and make your final judgment about the article.
game.controls: Mouse — point and click to use the interface and investigation tools
game.tips:
Keep notes on claims and the evidence you find.
Compare several clues before deciding; treat the AI checker as one tool in the investigation.
game.features:
Article-based detective puzzles
Simulated search and image-search tools
Source-link investigation
Fake-news checklist
English and German
Browser point-and-click play
game.short_description: Investigate suspicious articles and help an alien planet distinguish misinformation from trustworthy reporting.

game.title: KAIJU DISPOSAL
game.description:
KAIJU DISPOSAL is a browser management incremental about clearing giant carcasses from city streets. Queue two cuts for saw crews, haul materials to buyers, and balance fresh-part income against rot, gas buildup, and heat from the core.

Timed events alter priorities across twelve contracts. Between jobs, expand crews and transport or buy equipment upgrades. Generated monsters vary in body plan and species. If a job fails, the army finishes it, reputation falls, and the contract returns with a more patient city.
game.how_to_play: Select body parts for the cutting queue. Watch decay and timed events, let crews cut and trucks deliver, then invest between contracts.
game.controls:
Click / tap — order or cancel a cut
Space / P / Esc — pause
S — shop
1 / 2 / 4 — speed
M — sound
Arrows / drag — pan on the largest job
game.tips:
Watch the gut and hot core before committing both queued cuts.
Pause to reassess an event.
Match transport capacity to your cutting crews.
game.features:
Twelve-contract campaign
Procedural carcasses
Timed events and material buyers
Nine equipment upgrades
Automatic browser saving
Mouse, keyboard, and touch controls
game.short_description: Run a monster-cleanup company and choose your cuts before decay exhausts the city’s patience.

game.title: Leaf by Leaf
game.description:
Leaf by Leaf is a compact incremental prototype made for Mini Jam 221: Autumn and its Staying Warm limitation. Feed a bonfire with fallen leaves: each burned leaf earns coins and extends the fire’s life. When it goes out, the day ends.

At night, spend your earnings on a better blower, more leaves, and higher leaf values. Seventeen upgrades gradually unlock, including tornadoes that bring leaves into the fire automatically. The long-term goal is to grow a small campfire into a furnace capable of warming the world.
game.how_to_play: During daylight, direct leaves into the fire and keep them burning to earn coins. Once night falls, buy upgrades and begin another day. Repeat to grow the bonfire and unlock more tools.
game.controls:
Mouse — position the blower, which points toward the fire
Hold left click — blow leaves
Hover and click at night — select and buy upgrades
game.tips:
Keep leaves feeding the fire to extend each earning period.
Balance blower strength, leaf supply, and leaf value as you upgrade.
game.features:
Day-and-night progression
Coin rewards for burned leaves
Seventeen unlockable upgrades
Automatic leaf-carrying tornadoes
Pixel-art presentation
game.short_description: Blow leaves into a bonfire, buy nightly upgrades, and grow the fire day by day.

game.title: Lab accident
game.description:
Content note: body-transformation fetish themes and obsession. Lab accident is an interactive story by TWgrow set in a genetic research laboratory. An experimental serum changes Jenna, an intern hired by the player character, and shifts the relationship between them.

The creator describes the current story as linear, with six variations for Jenna and corresponding dialogue differences. Branching Act 2 routes are future plans rather than part of the currently described release. The project uses Twine and discloses AI-assisted graphics.

Pay attention to dialogue differences when comparing variations.

game.title: Dungeon Swap-R
game.description:
Dungeon Swap-R splits its puzzles into planning and traversal. During SWAP, rearrange rooms to build a route; during CRAWL, guide a fragile armored hero through the result. Items change enemy positions: the shield pushes a foe one room, while the graplin pulls one across two rooms.

If a layout fails, restart and return to planning. The current 1.3.0 version includes former community creations as built-in Bonus levels; the older online community service and level builder have been retired.
game.how_to_play: Find the exit marker and arrange a connected route in SWAP. Press Space to begin CRAWL, then navigate rooms and use items against enemies. Press R to return to SWAP if the arrangement does not work.
game.controls:
Space — switch from SWAP to CRAWL
R — restart and return to SWAP
Mouse wheel — zoom during CRAWL
Keyboard and mouse supported
game.tips:
Inspect the route and enemy positions before starting CRAWL.
Plan around the different displacement distances of the shield and graplin.
Zoom out when checking the overall layout.
game.features:
Two-phase dungeon puzzles
Room rearrangement
Enemy-displacement items
Restartable layouts
Built-in Bonus levels in version 1.3.0
game.short_description: Rearrange dungeon rooms, then crawl through your layout to reach the exit.
